relations.subject: Shechen Rabjam Rinpoche
relations.evidence: As he grew up, he began to think of him as his spiritual teacher. Once he began his studies, he realized that Khyentse Rinpoche embodied all the qualities of an authentic master

relations.subject: Shechen Rabjam Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Before leaving Tibet, my grandfather, Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche and his family visited Samye

relations.subject: Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche
relations.evidence: There was no one more precious to Dilgo Khyentse than his first root teacher, Shechen Gyaltsap Pema Namgyal.
